# Engoo

> > Engoo is a global 1-on-1 private online English tutoring platform connecting learners with 11,000+ native and international tutors from 120+ countries.

Engoo offers flexible English lessons for individual learners and businesses, with tutors specializing in conversation practice, business English, pronunciation, and language instruction across all proficiency levels. The platform serves students worldwide with customizable lesson plans and corporate training solutions.

## Key Topics

- 1-on-1 private tutoring
- Native English speakers
- International tutors
- Online English lessons
- Business English
- Conversation practice
- ESL instruction
- Language learning
- Corporate training
- Pronunciation coaching
- Flexible scheduling
- CELTA certification
- Student-centered learning
- Global tutor network
- Customizable lesson plans
